final: WITH c AS (SELECT o.account_id AS account_id, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM "order" o JOIN account a ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY o.account_id, d.A3), diffs AS (SELECT account_id, region, order_count, order_count - (SELECT AVG(order_count) FROM c) AS diff FROM c), r AS (SELECT account_id, region, order_count, diff, AVG(diff) OVER (PARTITION BY region) AS region_avg_diff FROM diffs) SELECT account_id, region, order_count, diff AS diff_from_overall_avg, diff - region_avg_diff AS excess_over_region_avg_diff FROM r WHERE diff > region_avg_diff ORDER BY excess_over_region_avg_diff DESC LIMIT 10
